cases_2p00kg_210m.source: LEAD CHANGELOG 227 (9) (RV6-05): GNC rev4 burn p99 8.443 / 8.270 s at 210 m against 8.446 / 8.227 s at 285 m (SIM, staged; two main bases)
cases_2p00kg_210m.note: time ratio against the 8.258 s A1 sizing counter, floored at 1 (a shorter burn keeps the 8.258 s tables); same tank and vehicle, so no thrust factor

findings: 2.00 kg at the decided 210 m target (RV6-05): the A1 burn p99 8.443 s is +0.185 s (+2.2 %) over the 8.258 s sizing counter; first order, nominal A1 throat-area growth 1.90 % per flight at n 0.5 (below the NZ-01 2 % criterion) and 2.10 % at n 0.68 (above it, as at 8.258 s: OI-40), residual web >= 7.15 mm (a x1.0 n 0.5) and >= 4.01 mm (band corner); the A1 tables on 8.258 s understate the A1 time by up to 2.2 %; B1 governs.

Nominal-model A1 throat-area growth goes from 1.86 % (8.24 s record) to 1.96-2.20 % per flight (time ratio, x thrust factor): the 8.92 s p99 and 9.24 s max cross the NZ-01 2 % criterion (OI-40) even on the nominal model; the conservative (8.9-10.0 %) and literature (9.5-16.1 %) models were already above ENG-06 5 % at 2.00 kg.
Residual web: >= 6.13 mm at a x1.0 n 0.5 and >= 2.54 mm at the band corner a x1.5 n 0.35 (9.24 s, largest A1 regression rate): ENG-06 >= 1 mm holds.
Thermal: the A1 burn (<= 9.24 s) stays well below B1 (21.8-23.6 s), which governs soak and insert life; A1 heat input rises <= 18 % (time x thrust factor).

Not covered (OPEN): B1 with the 2.20 kg tank (no GNC record: a heavier vehicle and +0.2 kg N2O change the B1 duty cycle that governs sizing), the A1 relight state at 210 m with 2.20 kg (OI-49), the wall-temperature rise of a longer burn (erosion rate grows with Tw, so linear scaling can understate), the longer tank structure.

open_item.text: 2.20 kg tank option: B1 and A1 records with the 2.20 kg tank (GNC), then S230 grain / erosion / thermal re-run (Combustion Tables 4.5, 4.6, 5.3, 6.x), tank and structure (Mechanical); until then the datasheet quotes the 2.20 kg option with "B1 / thermal / erosion TO-VERIFY" and this first-order A1 estimate.
